levelList.name: Boucher un trou
levelList.desc:
External effects cannot trigger this Skill to be reused
Clash Power +1 for every 4 ([Breath] Potency + [Charge] Count) on self (max 5)
Clash Power +2 for every [BulletHole]
[BeforeAttack] Spend all [BulletHole] and apply the following effects:
- Gain 2 [Breath] Potency, +1 [Breath] Count, and +2 [Charge] Count for every [BulletHole] spent
- Deal +8% damage for every [BulletHole] spent
If this Skill spent 5 [BulletHole], heal 5 SP
[EndSkill] Gain 1 [BulletHole]

Targets randomly
